title: Micron Demonstrates 512GB DDR5: Stacked DRAM for Higher-Capacity Server Memory
excerpt: An explanation of the 512GB DDR5 RDIMM demonstration Micron announced on September 15, 2026. We cover how DRAM is stacked with TSVs, why it matters for AI, the validation status, and the outlook for mass production in the second half of 2027.
